purpose: Supersede only the v3 injection/likelihood implementation before strain access: run the exact H1/L1 time-delay grids and correctly normalized profiled Whittle objective; preserve every v2/v3 scientific choice and claim ceiling.
frozen_reuse: All sources, kernel parameters, normalization, event placement, preprocessing, PSD definition, frequency band, equivalence families, time grids, countermodels, and claim ceilings are inherited byte-for-byte in meaning from v3.

injection_repair.noise: independent unit-variance circular complex Gaussian per retained frequency bin and detector
injection_repair.signal: same normalized injected template in both detectors, amplitude network_snr/sqrt(2), injected t0=0 and delta_LH=0
injection_repair.profile: for every candidate and cell maximize the analytic complex-amplitude score over all 411 common times and all 83 L1-H1 delays
injection_repair.fft_correlation: exact discrete circular frequency correlation on the 32768-point 8-second grid; declared grids are integer sample offsets
injection_repair.pass_rule: zero noncausal early-response detections and >=0.90 correct equivalence-family recovery for every injected kernel at network SNR 20

whittle_repair.complex_amplitude: one independent analytic coefficient per detector

calibration_diagnostic.role: stress test only, not a substitute for missing published uncertainty envelopes
